port.description: Comma-separated list of ports to listen on (e.g., '8080,8443' for HTTP and HTTPS).

num_threads.description: Number of worker threads. Use 0 to auto-detect based on CPU cores.

document_root.description: Filesystem path to serve as the document root.

index_files.description: List of filenames to try as default for a directory request, in order of preference.

enable_directory_listing.description: Whether to show a directory listing if no index file is found.

ssl_certificate.description: Path to combined SSL certificate and private key (PEM format). Leave empty to disable SSL.

enable_cgi.description: Enable or disable CGI script execution.

cgi_interpreter.description: Path to the CGI interpreter (e.g., /usr/bin/python3). Required if enable_cgi=true.

cgi_patterns.description: Space-separated list of file extensions to treat as CGI scripts.

enable_lua.description: Enable or disable embedded Lua scripting for dynamic content.

lua_script_prefix.description: URL prefix that maps to Lua scripts (e.g., requests to /lua/hello will execute /etc/civetweb/lua/hello.lua).

lua_script_dir.description: Filesystem directory containing Lua scripts (ignored if enable_lua=false).

listening_ip.description: IP address to bind to. Use 127.0.0.1 to restrict to localhost only.

max_request_size.description: Maximum allowed HTTP request size in bytes. 0 means unlimited.

access_log_file.description: Path to the access log file.

error_log_file.description: Path to the error log file.

enable_auth.description: Enable HTTP Basic Authentication for all requests.

auth_realm.description: Authentication realm shown to the user in the login prompt.

auth_file.description: Path to the password file (HtPasswd format) used for authentication.

extra_lines.description: Additional configuration lines to append verbatim (e.g., custom MIME types, security headers).

items.description: A single raw configuration line, such as 'add_header X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN'.
